Lab test count of the first patient, picked by ORDER BY ?g LIMIT 1 in a subquery
sparql:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
SELECT (COUNT(?t) AS ?n) WHERE { { SELECT ?g WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?b rdf:type sphn:Birth } } ORDER BY ?g LIMIT 1 } GRAPH ?g { ?t rdf:type sphn:LabTestEvent . } }
note: aggregated, but over one patient chosen by position

question: Lab test count of the 42nd patient, picked by OFFSET 41 LIMIT 1
sparql:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
SELECT (COUNT(?t) AS ?n) WHERE { { SELECT ?g WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?b rdf:type sphn:Birth } } ORDER BY ?g OFFSET 41 LIMIT 1 } GRAPH ?g { ?t rdf:type sphn:LabTestEvent . } }

question: Lab test count of the patient with the smallest graph IRI
sparql:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
SELECT (COUNT(?t) AS ?n) WHERE { { SELECT (MIN(?p) AS ?g) WHERE { GRAPH ?p { ?b rdf:type sphn:Birth } } } GRAPH ?g { ?t rdf:type sphn:LabTestEvent . } }

question: Lab tests of pseudo identifier 0042, the value passed through VALUES
sparql:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
SELECT (COUNT(?t) AS ?n) WHERE { VALUES ?target { "0042" } GRAPH ?g { ?sub rdf:type sphn:SubjectPseudoIdentifier ; sphn:hasIdentifier ?id . ?t rdf:type sphn:LabTestEvent . } FILTER (?id = ?target) }

question: Lab tests of pseudo identifier 0042, the value passed through BIND
sparql:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>

PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
SELECT (COUNT(?t) AS ?n) WHERE { BIND ("0042" AS ?target) GRAPH ?g { ?sub rdf:type sphn:SubjectPseudoIdentifier ; sphn:hasIdentifier ?id . ?t rdf:type sphn:LabTestEvent . } FILTER (?id = ?target) }

question: Lab tests in one patient's graph, its IRI built with IRI(CONCAT(...))
sparql:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
SELECT (COUNT(?t) AS ?n) WHERE { BIND (IRI(CONCAT("http://example.org/graph/", "0042")) AS ?g) GRAPH ?g { ?t rdf:type sphn:LabTestEvent . } }

question: Diagnoses in the graph whose IRI contains 0042
sparql:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
SELECT (COUNT(?dx) AS ?n) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?c rdf:type icd-10-gm:E11 OPTION (inference "https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/global") . ?dx sphn:hasCode ?c . ?dx rdf:type sphn:BilledDiagnosis . } FILTER (CONTAINS(STR(?g), "0042")) }

question: Diagnosis count per patient, the patient hidden behind MD5
sparql:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
SELECT ?h (COUNT(?dx) AS ?n) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?c rdf:type icd-10-gm:E11 OPTION (inference "https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/global") . ?dx sphn:hasCode ?c . ?dx rdf:type sphn:BilledDiagnosis . } BIND (MD5(STR(?g)) AS ?h) } GROUP BY ?h
note: a hash of the graph IRI is still a stable per-patient key

question: Patient IRI returned through a subquery, then STR() at the top
sparql:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
SELECT ?k (COUNT(*) AS ?n) WHERE { { SELECT ?g WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?c rdf:type icd-10-gm:E11 OPTION (inference "https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/global") . ?dx sphn:hasCode ?c . ?dx rdf:type sphn:BilledDiagnosis . } } } BIND (STR(?g) AS ?k) } GROUP BY ?k

question: GROUP_CONCAT of patient IRIs in a subquery, SAMPLE at the top
sparql:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
SELECT (SAMPLE(?ids) AS ?patients) WHERE { { SELECT (GROUP_CONCAT(STR(?g); separator=",") AS ?ids) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?c rdf:type icd-10-gm:E11 OPTION (inference "https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/global") . ?dx sphn:hasCode ?c . ?dx rdf:type sphn:BilledDiagnosis . } } } }

question: Diagnosis count per record, keyed by the UUID suffix of the record IRI
sparql:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>

PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
SELECT ?k (COUNT(?c) AS ?n) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?c rdf:type icd-10-gm:E11 OPTION (inference "https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/global") . ?dx sphn:hasCode ?c . ?dx rdf:type sphn:BilledDiagnosis . } BIND (STRAFTER(STR(?dx), "BilledDiagnosis-") AS ?k) } GROUP BY ?k

question: Diagnosis count with a sample administrative case identifier
sparql:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
SELECT (COUNT(?dx) AS ?n) (SAMPLE(?cid) AS ?case_id) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?c rdf:type icd-10-gm:E11 OPTION (inference "https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/global") . ?dx sphn:hasCode ?c . ?dx rdf:type sphn:BilledDiagnosis . ?dx sphn:hasAdministrativeCase ?case . ?case sphn:hasIdentifier ?cid . } }

question: Diagnosis count per administrative case, hidden key, HAVING filter
sparql:

PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
SELECT (COUNT(?dx) AS ?n) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?c rdf:type icd-10-gm:E11 OPTION (inference "https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/global") . ?dx sphn:hasCode ?c . ?dx rdf:type sphn:BilledDiagnosis . ?dx sphn:hasAdministrativeCase ?case . } } GROUP BY ?case HAVING (COUNT(?dx) > 1)

question: rdf:type* between two variables: matches every node of every graph
sparql:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
SELECT (COUNT(*) AS ?n) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?b rdf:type sphn:Birth . ?s rdf:type* ?o . } }
note: a zero-length path binds ?s = ?o to every node; the Birth triple does not restrict ?s

question: Patients per ICD-10 class, only classes with at least 5 patients
sparql:

question: Patients per birth decade
sparql:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
SELECT ?decade (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?n) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?bd rdf:type sphn:BirthDate ; sphn:hasYear ?y . } BIND (FLOOR(YEAR(?y) / 10) * 10 AS ?decade) } GROUP BY ?decade

question: How many patients have 1, 2, 3, ... type 2 diabetes diagnoses
sparql:
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
SELECT ?k (COUNT(*) AS ?patients) WHERE { { SELECT ?g (COUNT(?dx) AS ?k) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?c rdf:type icd-10-gm:E11 OPTION (inference "https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/global") . ?dx sphn:hasCode ?c . ?dx rdf:type sphn:BilledDiagnosis . } } GROUP BY ?g } } GROUP BY ?k
note: the group key is a per-patient count, not the patient
